title: Nimaya Williams earns $40,000 BigFuture scholarship as one of only two students nationwide
summary_full: Nimaya Williams has achieved a remarkable milestone by securing a $40,000 scholarship from College Board's BigFuture. This accolade was awarded to her for completing various college and career planning tasks available on their platform. The financial support alleviates a significant burden for her family regarding higher education costs, showcasing how strategic planning can create unforeseen pathways to success.
